bdsg.muc_dich: Ban de danh gia. Huan luyen tren MOT GPU thue theo gio; chay suy luan van duoc tren may ca nhan co 4 GB RAM tro len.
bdsg.ten_truong_theo_chuan_nao: Ten cac truong o tren la CHUAN TRANSFORMERS — quy uoc chung cua he sinh thai mo hinh mo, khong phai cua rieng du an nao. Khoa 'bdsg' la ghi chu, phai bo truoc khi goi CauHinhBDSG(**cfg).

tham_so.trang_thai: TINH RA, CHUA DEM TREN MO HINH THAT (26/09/2026).

bo_nho.don_vi_ghi_chu: MiB = 1024^2 byte, GiB = 1024^3, KiB = 1024. Kho tinh theo luy thua 2 vi cau hoi thuc te la co vua RAM/VRAM khong, ma RAM va VRAM deu dem theo luy thua 2. mo-hinh/cau_hinh.py in CUNG cac dai luong nay theo MB THAP PHAN (1e6 byte) nen so ben do lon hon 4,86%: hai don vi, khong phai hai ket qua. Khoa trong_so_fp16_MB_thap_phan ben duoi la cung luong byte ay doi sang MB thap phan, vi kich thuoc tep tai ve thi the gioi quen doc theo don vi do.
bo_nho.huan_luyen_tinh_ra_sao: 119.563.008 * 16 byte / 1024^3 = 1,78 GiB trang thai toi uu (trong so fp32 + gradient + hai moment). CHUA co activation.

phan_cung_that.suy_luan: May ca nhan tu 4 GB RAM: trong so fp32 456 MiB + bo dem KV 32 MiB o ngu canh day. TINH RA, chua do.
phan_cung_that.huan_luyen: Mot GPU 12 GB tro len (vi du RTX 3060 12GB, 4070, A4000): 1,78 GiB trang thai toi uu con lai hon 10 GB cho activation va bo dem. Tren CPU thi ve BO NHO la du (may 8 GB RAM), nhung khong khuyen — xem muc toc_do.
phan_cung_that.toc_do: CHUA DO tren bat ky may nao. Khong co con so token/giay nao de dua ra. Dieu duy nhat noi duoc chac: mo hinh nay co 3,3 lan so tham so cua ban nho, nen moi buoc huan luyen se dat hon chung ay lan — nhung do la ti le, khong phai phep do.

vi_sao_chon_so_nay: 16 lop tren hidden 768 (sau chu khong rong): o ngan sach tham so nho, tang so lop thuong an hon tang be rong. Day la QUYET DINH THIET KE dua tren thuc hanh pho bien trong cac mo hinh mo cung co, KHONG phai ket qua do cua BDSG — BDSG chua chay thi nghiem A/B nao ve chuyen nay va noi thang ra day.

num_attention_heads=12 voi head_dim=64: 12 * 64 = 768 = hidden_size, khong phong to khong thu nho o lop chu y. Giu head_dim=64 giong ban nho la co y — doi head_dim giua cac ban lam thay doi ca hinh dang bang RoPE, khien khong so sanh duoc hai ban voi nhau.
num_key_value_heads=4 tren 12 query head: ti le GQA 3:1. Bo dem KV con 1/3 so voi MHA — 16 KiB thay vi 48 KiB moi token.
intermediate_size=2048 = 8/3 * 768 dung bang, khong phai lam tron: 768 * 8 / 3 = 2048 chan.

vocab_size, max_position_embeddings, rope_theta, tie_word_embeddings: GIU Y HET ban nho. Ba cau hinh phai la mot HO mo hinh — cung tu vung, cung tran ngu canh, cung cach ma hoa vi tri — de bo danh gia dung chung va de so sanh chung voi nhau co nghia.
canh_bao: 1,78 GiB chi la trang thai toi uu. KHONG duoc dung con so do de hua 'vua mot GPU 8GB' — chua tinh activation, va activation o batch lon co the vuot ca trang thai toi uu.
Ap dung nguyen canh bao vocab_size o nho.json.
So tham so la SO TINH RA, doi chieu voi phep dem that khi da co mo-hinh/.
